Question 3
?

Solve the initial value problem y″−4y′+8y=20e2x,y(0)=1,  y′(0)=2.

a
y=e2x(cos⁡2x−sin⁡2x)+5e2x
b
y=−4e2xcos⁡2x+5e2x
c
y=e2x(−2cos⁡2x+4sin⁡2x)−e2x
d
y=3e2xsin⁡x+e2x
e
y=e2x(3cos⁡x+2sin⁡x)+5e2x
